iti81:2.1: Diṭṭhā mayā bhikkhave sattā sakkārena abhibhūtā pariyādinnacittā kāyassa bhedā param-maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapannā;
iti81:3.1: diṭṭhā mayā bhikkhave sattā asakkārena abhibhūtā pariyādinnacittā kāyassa bhedā param-maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapannā;
iti81:4.1: diṭṭhā mayā bhikkhave sattā sakkārena ca asakkārena ca tadubhayena abhibhūtā pariyādinnacittā kāyassa bhedā param-maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapannā.
iti81:5.1: Taṃ kho panāhaṃ bhikkhave na aññassa samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā sutvā vadāmi: Diṭṭhā mayā bhikkhave sattā sakkārena abhibhūtā pariyādinnacittā kāyassa bhedā param-maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapannā; diṭṭhā mayā bhikkhave sattā asakkārena abhibhūtā pariyādinnacittā kāyassa bhedā param-maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapannā; diṭṭhā mayā bhikkhave sattā sakkārena ca asakkārena ca tadubhayena abhibhūtā pariyādinnacittā kāyassa bhedā param-maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapannā.
iti81:5.2: Api ca bhikkhave yad-eva me sāmañ-ñātaṃ sāmaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sāmaṃ viditaṃ tadevāhaṃ vadāmi:
iti81:6.1: Diṭṭhā mayā bhikkhave sattā sakkārena abhibhūtā pariyādinnacittā kāyassa bhedā param-maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapannā;
iti81:7.1: diṭṭhā mayā bhikkhave sattā asakkārena abhibhūtā pariyādinnacittā kāyassa bhedā param-maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapannā;
iti81:8.1: diṭṭhā mayā bhikkhave sattā sakkārena ca asakkārena ca tadubhayena abhibhūtā pariyādinnacittā kāyassa bhedā param-maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapannā ti.
